pescribed appendix

the proviions of the Act.

5. Copy of resignation letter (in case of resignation of a director or chief executive), duly signed by
resigning director or chief executive, verified through an affidavit on stamp paper duly signed by the
person who has signed this Form and attested by an oath commissioner and witnessed, be
attached.
